# discord_stickers (Data Source)

Lists the custom stickers of a server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_stickers" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `stickers` (Attributes List) The stickers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stickers))

<a id="nestedatt--stickers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stickers`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the sticker can be used; false when the server lost the boosts it needs.
- `description` (String) Sticker description.
- `format_type` (String) File format: `png`, `apng`, `lottie`, `gif`.
- `id` (String) Sticker ID.
- `name` (String) Sticker name.
- `tags` (String) Autocomplete and suggestion tags.
